# Scribl D2C MVP Scope

_Source artifact: `s2d/inputs/scribl-d2c-mvp-scope.pdf`. Generated by context-ingest; do not hand-edit._

Overview  
Scribl has the opportunity to launch a Direct-to-Consumer (D2C) mobile application centered 
around a daily creative practice, inspired by the habit-forming dynamics of products like Wordle, 
NYT Games, and BeReal. The experience would deliver one universal daily prompt to all users, 
enabling lightweight creative expression, social sharing, and long-term habit formation through 
streaks, progression, and creative identity. In partnership with Bounteous, Anthropic, and AWS 
Scribl can rapidly develop and launch an MVP within the coming months to validate 
engagement, retention, and monetization potential. This initiative represents an opportunity to 
explore a new consumer growth engine beyond Scribl's current enterprise motion while 
positioning the company at the intersection of AI, creativity, and social engagement.  
Scope / User Experience  
1. Daily Prompt 
● One universal prompt delivered daily to all users 
● Shared participation creates community and cultural relevance 
○ You only get to see others art once you have submitted yours (that's the unlock) 
2. Creative Response 
● Lightweight creation experience  
○ Drawing canvas on your phone 
○ Tell your story via text or voice recording (restricted character count/audio length) 
3. Social Sharing 
● Groups/Channels (Limit to 4 in the MVP) 
○ Channel 1 - Personal Archive 
○ Channel 2 - (ex. Family) 
○ Channel 3 - (ex. Friends) 
○ Channel 4 - (ex. Co-Workers) 
● Lightweight reactions and engagement 
○ Standardized set of sentiment emojis 
4. Progression & Achievement  
● Creative streaks 
○ stats 
○ badges 
○ milestones 

○ retention loops 
● Personal archives - "Your Channel" 
5. Push Notification Habit Loop 
● Daily prompt reminders 
● Friend activity updates 
● Momentum-based retention 
● *Personalized follow-ups based on stories shared (ex. Are you staying on top of your 
hydration goal?)  
6. Data & Insights (Internal) 
● Retention & Habit Formation: Track retention, daily active users, streak participation, and 
notification return rates to determine whether Scribl is becoming a repeatable daily 
behavior. 
● Prompt Engagement: Measure prompt open rates, completion rates, time spent creating, 
and which prompt themes drive the highest engagement, sharing, and repeat usage. 
● Social & Viral Growth: Monitor share rates, friend invites, reactions, and social 
participation to understand whether the product naturally drives network effects and 
organic user acquisition. 
● Monetization Signals: Capture early indicators of premium intent, including engagement 
with archives, AI-powered features, premium prompts, and willingness-to-pay behaviors. 
● Qualitative User Insights: Gather user feedback, testimonials, emotional reactions, and 
favorite prompt types to better understand what makes the experience emotionally 
resonant and habit-forming.
